title: [Linux, Intel Mesa] Godot crashes when starting a scene with MeshInstance3D on Mobile Renderer
body:
### Tested versions


- Reproducible in: 4.6.beta2 [551ce8d47] official build, v4.6.beta.custom_build [63227bbc8].
- Not reproducible in: 4.5.1.stable.


### System information

Godot v4.6.beta (63227bbc8) - Arch Linux #1 SMP PREEMPT_DYNAMIC Thu, 18 Dec 2025 18:00:18 +0000 on Wayland - Wayland display driver, Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Mobile) - integrated Intel(R) UHD Graphics (TGL GT2) - 11th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i3-1115G4 @ 3.00GHz (4 threads) - 15.39 GiB memory

### Issue description

The game crashes when initializing a certain scene on Mobile renderer.  There are no problems with Forward+

I tried to recreate the scene from the original GLB file, but one of the meshes still crashes Godot Editor.
